htdt-godogen-asset-gen.description: Generate game assets, locally and free by default with godogen_assets: images and transparent PNGs (Qwen-Image), textured GLB models (TRELLIS.2), rigged humanoids with generated moves and lip-synced speech, sound effects and voice lines. Paid APIs cover what the local tools can't make — Gemini / xAI Grok images, animated sprites from video, Tripo 3D, Gemini TTS voice acting, Lyria music. Use whenever a game needs generated art or audio.
